solutions.title: BFS on labels 1…n²
solutions.notes: Each roll is an edge; teleport if board says so
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Breadth-first search over board squares; first time you reach the end is shortest.

**Example walkthrough:** BFS from square `1`. Each move tries dice 1–6; if you land on a ladder/snake cell, teleport. The first time `36` is reached, the distance is `4`.
